_comment: Model registry (PROJECT_BRIEF.md 4.2). Everything marked 'verified' was observed on the real bucket. Entries not yet probed say so, and the client treats them as unavailable.
Paths: {ymd} = YYYYMMDD, {hh} = cycle hour (2 digits), {f3} / {f2} = forecast hour (3 / 2 digits), {kind} = the REFS product (mean | sprd | prob | avrg | eas).
cycles: the cycle hours that exist, with the forecast length each one reaches. Code must still check that the file exists (brief 4.5); this is the plan, not a promise.
latencyMin: roughly how long after cycle time f000 appears. Used to decide 'stale' and to avoid probing cycles that can't exist yet.

models.label: HRRR · full column (GRIB, ~50 MB an hour viewed)
models.verified: 2026-09-27: AWS noaa-hrrr-bdp-pds listed, CORS open incl. Range, .idx read; Lambert 3.30 1799x1059, packing 5.3, winds grid-relative

tke.note: Model turbulent kinetic energy (MYNN) on native levels 1-16 (to ~3.9 km). Heights above ground are the Salish Sea medians from config/hrrr_hybrid_agl.json (scripts/hrrr_hybrid_heights.mjs), within ~5% of the actual level heights below 2 km.

models.notes: wrfprs has VVEL (ω), converted to w in the page. wrfsfc has only 10 m and 80 m winds above ground. Winds are grid-relative, turned to true north. Packs (pipeline/packs/build.py) remain available for a scheduled job later.
models.liveNote: radar-explorer's approach (web/model/hrrrgrib.js there) for the whole column: each field and level is one range request for the whole-CONUS message (~0.6-0.9 MB), decoded in workers and cropped. Measured 2026-09-27: 77 messages (every 50 mb to 500 mb) = 49 MB, ~7 s; 203 messages (every 25 mb to 300 mb) = 131 MB, ~15 s.
models.jitNote: Just in time: every hour loads the core set (surface, 10/80 m winds, wind + height 1000-850 mb, ≈ 15 MB); other fields and levels load when a display needs them.
models.subhNote: 15-minute 10 m wind and gust for the first 18 h (file fFF: steps at (FF-1)h+15/30/45 min and FF h; the top of the hour comes from the hourly data). Verified 2026-09-27 on the real .idx.

models.preferred: the default for the Salish Sea (2026-09-29, owner): the whole run in ~45 MB; the full-column GRIB HRRR is offered when something on screen needs it
models.label: HRRR · light (Zarr, ~45 MB a whole run; 5 levels)
models.verified: 2026-09-27: s3://hrrrzarr sfc/<day>/<day>_<HH>z_fcst.zarr listed; CORS open; chunks [T,150,150] float32 Blosc/LZ4 (~1-1.5 MB per variable-tile for a 48 h run); forecast_period array gives the hours

columnTops.label: to ≈ 5.8 km (500 mb): all this source has

models.noInversion: HRRR's Zarr forecast has only 925, 850 and 700 mb in the 950-600 mb search band: too coarse to resolve a capping inversion. Use RRFS for that.
models.zarrNote: Coarse column from the Utah Zarr (HRRR's surface file): winds at 10 m, 80 m and 1000/925/850/700/500 mb; RH from T and dewpoint; 925 mb height by the hypsometric equation; vorticity computed from the winds; w only at 700 mb. One download per run (all hours), then playback is instant.

models.label: RRFS (deterministic) · Hawaiʻi 2.5 km
models.verified: 2026-09-27: listed noaa-rrfs-ops-pds, read .idx, decoded messages matching ecCodes, and fetched cross-origin with Range from a browser
models.levelsNote: prslev has 45 isobaric levels: 1000-100 mb every 25 mb, then 70, 50, 30, 20, 10, 7, 5, 2. The explorer loads 1000 mb up to a chosen column top (default 300 mb ≈ 9 km).

fields.UGRD: u wind (grid-relative on Mercator = true east), m/s
fields.DZDT: vertical velocity w, m/s (geometric; NOT ω, no conversion needed)

models.notes: Not in prslev: HPBL (PBL height). Check 2dfld before assuming. On a Mercator grid, grid-relative winds are true east/north, so they need no rotation (unlike HRRR's Lambert grid).
models.subhNote: 15-minute 10 m wind and gust for the first 18 h (file fFF: steps at (FF-1)h+15/30/45 min and FF h; the top of the hour comes from the hourly data). Verified 2026-09-27 on the real .idx.

models.label: REFS ensemble · Hawaiʻi (mean + spread)
models.verified: 2026-09-27: listed noaa-rrfs-ops-pds and read the mean/sprd/prob .idx files

fields.UGRD: mean / spread at 10 m and 925, 850, 700, 550, 500, 250 mb
fields.WIND: mean speed at 10 m, 80 m, 925, 850, 550, 250 mb. Read it, don't derive it: averaging member vectors cancels disagreement (salish-sea-briefing)

models.notes: Too few levels for inversion detection. That comes from deterministic RRFS only. Publishes mean and spread, never individual members (brief 4.7). REFS moves to prod paths on 2026-10-14 on NOMADS; watch whether the ops bucket paths change too.

models.notes: Served as packs for the same reason as HRRR (CONUS messages can't be cropped by byte range).
models.liveNote: CONUS messages can't be cropped by byte range, so each forecast hour downloads whole-CONUS messages: measured 2026-09-27 in a browser, 55 messages = 63 MB in 4.4 s + 2.6 s decode. The live column is every 50 mb (11 levels to 500 mb, all 7 fields) plus the surface/above-ground set: ~110 MB and ~12 s an hour on a fast connection. Fine for looking at a few hours on a desktop; not for smooth playback or phones (packs would be).
